messages.subject: Project Cedar — Licence Agreement (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
Deepa, Oliver,

Attached is our response to your mark-up. In summary: we accept the 45-day cure and the 60% third-party deduction; on the running royalty we propose 5.5% as a meeting point; and we've moved the liability cap to £4m. We've also added a short reasonableness gloss on withholding consent to sub-licences where the proposed sub-licensee competes with Larkmoor outside the field.

We think this is very close. Happy to finalise on a call.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

Deepa
